finding.claim: Server-supplied redirect_url makes the client connect to a server-chosen host with the original configured password, because permitRedirect defaults to true and the redirect options copy this.opts including password.
finding.source: redirect_url session-state value in OK packet (lib/cmd/parser.js:169-171) or handshake OK (lib/cmd/handshake/authentication.js:100-103), passed to redirect() at lib/connection.js:1593.
finding.sink: new ConnOptions(Object.assign({}, this.opts, redirectOpts)) and new Connection(...).connect() at lib/connection.js:1633-1636, which authenticates to the new host with the original password.

trace.note: redirect_url read from server session-state tracking
redirect allowed when receiveQueue<=1 and not in transaction
URL user applied only if present
original opts (including password) copied into redirect options

finding.guards_checked: permitRedirect default true (connection-options.js:90) so not disabled by default; same-host check only (connection.js:1621); scheme check mariadb:/mysql: only; no host allowlist; no check that password is not forwarded; TLS verification (rejectUnauthorized default true) limits cleartext exposure only when cert validation holds; redirect comment at 1627 says only user/password are accepted, contradicted by code.

finding.claim: With permitSetMultiParamEntries enabled, object keys are written inside backticks without escaping, so a request-controlled JSON key can inject SQL into SET or WHERE clauses.
finding.source: Object keys of a plain-object query value (e.g. parsed request body) passed as ? parameter to query(sql, values).
finding.sink: out.writeString('`' + key + '`') at lib/cmd/encoder/text-encoder.js:135, building SQL sent to the server; same pattern in lib/misc/utils.js:213 for Connection.escape.

trace.note: for (let key in value) iterates attacker-chosen keys
key concatenated into backtick identifier with no escaping
same unescaped key concatenation in Connection.escape path

finding.guards_checked: Option is opt-in (default false). Values are escaped via writeParam/writeStringEscapeQuote, but keys are not; escapeId (lib/misc/utils.js:91-107) exists but is not used for keys; no backtick rejection. Not executed (Bash unavailable); verified by reading only.
